summary: Investing.com -- S&P Global Ratings downgraded Salesforce Inc (NYSE:CRM) to 'A' from 'A+', pointing to an increasingly aggressive capital allocation strategy characterized by debt-funded shareholder returns and large-scale acquisitions.
